responsibility: This file implements a small RTL pass that determines whether the stack pointer remains unchanged throughout a function prior to prologue/epilogue emission. It scans instructions for direct or implicit stack-pointer modifications, initializes crtl->sp_is_unchanging from alloca usage, and updates DF exit-block uses when the property becomes known. Its output is a backend property used by targets that can emit simpler epilogues or make other decisions when the function never adjusts the stack pointer.
